numeric.question: Compute the total volume passing through any detected cycle; compare to KYC declared monthly volume.
numeric.calculation:
1. Identify repeated counterparty "AM Logistics LLC" with two transactions (2026-04-08 and 2026-04-10), each amounting to 56051.69 USD.
2. Sum the amounts to get cycle volume: 56051.69 + 56051.69 = 112103.38 USD.
3. Compare to KYC declared monthly volume of 2041684.0 USD.
4. Compute ratio: 112103.38 / 2041684.0 ≈ 0.0549, i.e., about 0.055 times the declared volume.
